profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer | Scaling AI-Driven Mortgage Tech & Unified Data Solutions
profile.summary: Software Engineer with experience in Multi-Tenant Web Application Architecture, Performance & Brand Marketing, User Tracking Analytics, SEO, PII & PCI Security Standards.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote
positions.description: Engineering the "middle" of the mortgage industry. Leading development of high-scale, products designed to streamline the loan manufacturing process. By transitioning fragmented vendor data into unified, intelligent workflows, I help lenders eliminate friction and make faster, data-backed decisions

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Principal Architect for the Quicken Loans brand, owning the end-to-end technical roadmap for the digital product and marketing suite across all web platforms.

Re-architected core platforms to maximize SEO rankings and organic search conversion - delivering a 242% lift in mobile and 105% in desktop Core Web Vitals.

Designed and enhanced unified tracking and A/B testing framework to capture engagement signals and user intent, leveraging marketing analytics to optimize retention, conversion funnels, and multi-touch attribution.

positions.title: Senior Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design and develop performance marketing technical solutions across Quicken Loans' sites for over 3.6 million visitors per month (e.g., QuickenLoans, Marketplace, Refinance, Mortgage, chatbots) - including automating content creation (AI/LLM), personalizing customer experiences, analyzing data for trends and sentiment, driving improved engagement, A/B testing, lead generation, and conversion through targeted marketing campaigns to drive higher ROI.

Implemented and ensured OWASP-compliant, secure authentication mechanisms, and optimized SEO integrated with CRM/CMS systems across Quicken Loans' user accounts access - including optimizing site architecture, schema markup, metadata, load times, and CMS marketing blog publication to enhance content SEO, boost search rankings, and increase organic traffic.

Spearheaded rebranding and modernization of monolithic legacy apps - streamlining marketing funnels, improved user experience and conversion rates across marketing platforms.

Ensured cross-browser, device, and social platform compatibility (Facebook, Google, TikTok, Instagram) to maximize marketing reach, user experience, and reliable analytical metrics.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Feature development for legacy and new products in compliance with PCI Security Standards to support up to 6.5 million concurrent users.

Design and migrate legacy award, incentive, and claim programs into a single SaaS (Software as a Service) multi-tenant authenticated platform.

Implement shift-left methodologies to improve quality and speed of the development cycle through pipeline test automation - increasing velocity while decreasing defects of the software development life cycle.

Strategize, decouple, and condense business services into common processes.

positions.title: Lead Engineering Quality Assurance and Test Automation (SDET)
positions.description:
Led Quality Assurance in embedded HDD/SSD firmware quality and test automation. 

Created, owned, and maintained firmware quality's Test Automation Management System for Feature, Continuous Integration, and Performance concurrent pipelines managing over 250,000 executed tests per month.

Develop and maintained automated tools which analyzes multiple test logs and generates a summarized bug report - reducing 45 hours of daily log reading and bug reporting. 

Proposed and created shift-left strategies which increased test coverage and reliability upwards of 90%.

Participated in SAFe Agile in defining test requirements, planning, strategy, and execution.

Trained worldwide cross functional teams on new practices and procedures using SAFe Agile - expanding research development and legacy product quality coverage.

positions.title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineering Technician
positions.description:
Proposed, designed, planned, and created new solutions to test environment infrastructure.

Test case execution and bug reporting. Investigation of test results to find out root causes of failures by debugging system, application, and server logs and generate detailed and categorized bug cases and reports.

positions.title: Service Technician Manager
positions.description:
• Led the IT service team in a high-paced retail environment and responsible for delegating daily tasks, setting goals, provide reports on operations and projection, and accurately plan and complete tasks before project deadlines.

• Established positive relations between internal and external customers by providing product and service solutions. Strong knowledge in PC and Mac hardware components and diagnostics software and ability to anticipate and determine the root cause of hardware or software failure and conduct repair.

• Knowledgeable in installing and upgrading Windows, Apple, and Linux operating systems, installing drivers, and software. Use of electrical voltmeters, soldering irons, and computer repair tools.
